pr_15741_tool_oom.causal_conclusion: The second kernel OOM kill explains the exec-server exit and transport/session loss. The evidence does not support a stale-session delete as the initial fault or a standalone websocket fault.

The pinned bundled Codex 0.162.1 exec-server does not expose per-command memory/cgroup placement or pre-exec controls. The CLI supports CODEX_EXEC_SERVER_URL; replacing the executor is a separate architecture and ownership decision covering process, session, PTY, sandbox and filesystem behavior.
